prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Search for and grab object. Approach, check and do specific task. If unavailable, scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    /> <Action ID = GrabObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToDestination    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectFound    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeld    /> <Action ID = PickUpObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectWeight    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Action ID = MoveToSearchArea    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickUpObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToDestination
			IF IsObjectHeld? THEN
			DO CheckObjectWeight
	ELSE
		DO SpecificTask
	END
